description: This file defines a PHP class VacancyAPI within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling API endpoints for vacancy management in the recruitment module. It includes methods for CRUD operations, validation rules, and interactions with the Vacancy entity, along with API documentation annotations.

classes.name: VacancyAPI
classes.description: API controller class for managing recruitment vacancy entities, including CRUD operations and validation logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single vacancy by its ID, returning detailed vacancy data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all vacancies with filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new vacancy entity based on request data.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Populates a Vacancy object with data from the request, validating related entity existence.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a specific vacancy by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing vacancies with filters.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the response model class based on query parameters.

methods.name: getModelClassParamRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a vacancy.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Provides shared validation rules for vacancy creation and update.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing vacancy based on request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a vacancy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more vacancies by IDs.
